events.text: Citing border encroachments and bitter territorial grievances, Corporate Protectorate of Hoty mobilizes its hosts against Shahdom of Ralukegird. Banners unfurl for the Hoty–Ralukegird War.
Strange portents disturb the folk of Hasee: two-headed calves are born and springs run wine-dark. Priests offer fervent sacrifices.
Artificers and scholars achieve a historic breakthrough: Designer Pharmacology (Penicillin Crystallization, Synthetic Sulfa Compounds) spreads between guilds and academies across the realms!
COVERT INTRIGUE: Shadow agents from Datsazhi divert 25 gold from the tax vaults of Sewchaw!
COVERT INTRIGUE: Shadow agents from Nehuhuhewere divert 25 gold from the tax vaults of Vugvassuvriq!
QUEST COMPLETED: Search for the Lost Relic in Forika! Hala unlocks the sealed adamantine vault, unearthing the sacred relic Ancient Shard of Titlasgug to global acclaim!
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Zotödu pave the Shordu-Rashu Royal Road, establishing a direct route between Shordu and Rashu (+trade, +stability).
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Vugvassuvriq pave the Vugvassuvriq-Rutitaroa Royal Road, establishing a direct route between Vugvassuvriq and Rutitaroa (+trade, +stability).
NATURE BLESSING: Gorath the Stone Peak heaves rich subterranean veins to the surface of Dupobu! Granite ramparts harden against all siegecraft (+25 gold, +15 stability).
RUINOUS GIFT: Khorvath the Blood Lord floods the warriors of Fepinui with bloodthirsty slaughter! Mortal legions butcher foes with demonic savagery (+25% army power, -8 stability).
NATURE BLESSING: Undina of the Silver Basin purifies the sacred rivers of Ru'urhyth! Abundant fish and unhindered river trade enrich the townships (+30 gold, +12 stability).
RUINOUS GIFT: Tzannik the Architect of Fate mutates the weave of fate in Ralukegird! Arcane mutations grant uncanny clairvoyance and secret gold, at the cost of civil panic (+30 gold, -6 stability).
Street preacher Tsizady hands out free firmware in Chipadubibo, promising minds unlocked from Bitsabia.
Unrest of the year: bread riots in Lujgaj (Tissim).

An aqueduct reaches Tlia; fountains run in every square of Porta Clu.
The Verdant Guild of Dun Mec finds patrons in Te Lari.
A cold upwelling chills the domes of Lytsia; kelp farms wither and the reefs bleach.
TAX REVOLT: the undercity of Hauroex bars the shaft to Porta Clu, and the data-tithe-collectors of Porta Clu are turned back at the lamps of Luoxloyl.
Flames engulf the towers of Ralukegird! Soldiers of Hoty force the inner courtyards of Ralukegird's capital; the royal garrison breaks, and the seat of power falls.

The final citadels fall, and the board of Shahdom of Ralukegird is broken forever. With treasuries emptied and borders dissolved, Shopa Kona flees into bitter exile as the corp-state fades into legend.
Envoys convene upon neutral ground to ratify a solemn treaty, concluding the Hoty–Ralukegird War after less than a year. With frontiers redrawn, Hoty & Yulikota dictate terms to the vanquished.
Feast of the Return Voyage: Boats of Te Lari are blessed and raced off Te Lari; sailors are toasted ashore.
Êthâ II of Tissim takes up the cause of knowledge.
In the royal halls of Tissim, Inâ the Conqueror Kâkmâth breathes their last, succumbing to old age. Êthâ ascends the ancestral boardroom amid solemn acclamation.
Zaba II of Hoty turns from the old cause toward vengeance.
In the royal halls of Hoty, Zaba the Great Bazuhov breathes their last, succumbing to poison. Zaba ascends the ancestral boardroom amid solemn acclamation.
Hala (Grand Champion) sets an unprecedented record in the sprint and javelin throwing trials in Tetumuti.
Pabjuch (Master Artificer) invents an ingenious optical telescope to survey distant constellations in Mo'bowkab.
COVERT INTRIGUE: Assassins from Zotödu strike in the dead of night, slaying Fapara in the court of Hongeha!
DIPLOMATIC SCANDAL: Envoys of Loixyth are expelled after their covert spies are unmasked in Hongeha!

The Order of the Clean Upload spreads through Lijnufqas’s darknet, preaching that uploading the soul is the only salvation.

The last patron of the Hollow Guild of Qa'ylleoh turns on it: Loixyth burns its works and silences the masters.
Delvers of Porta Clu break into a hall of glowing crystals beyond Brepra; the deep realm grows.

COUP D'ETAT: Armed regiments loyal to Ronurufa storm the government palace in Fepinui! The faction seizes control, establishing the Syndicate of Fepinui.

POPULAR REVOLUTION: Crowds fill the avenues of Lyyghyeh as a mass uprising topples the boardroom of Megacorp of Lyyghyeh! The ancient autocracy is abolished, and Li'ekhiax proclaims the sovereign Republic of Lyyghyeh!

STATE ATHEISM PROCLAIMED: The revolutionary leadership in Lyyghyeh enacts Radical Secularization! State religion is abolished, data-shrine estates and monastery vaults are confiscated for the people (+65 gold), and ancient dogma is suppressed.
COVERT INTRIGUE: Clandestine agents from Sewchaw sow suspicion in the frontier councils of Zotödu.
QUEST UNDERTAKEN: Blimra embarks upon the Repairing the Broken Aqueduct of Blecri! Blimra learns that the aqueduct arches of Blecri have cracked in the hard frost.

species.name: Human
species.desc: Versatile and ambitious mortals who build sprawling empires across every continent.

species.name: Elf
species.desc: Graceful, long-lived beings attuned to primal magic, ancient forests, and stellar harmonies.

species.name: Dwarf
species.desc: Stout, resolute masters of masonry, deep mining, and forged steel who carve citadels into living stone.

species.name: Orc
species.desc: Fierce, muscular warriors governed by martial honor, blood covenants, and relentless resilience.

species.name: Troll
species.desc: Massive, regenerative brutes of mossy crags and deep wetlands possessing primeval strength.

species.name: Beastman
species.desc: Prideful therianthropic folk bearing lupine, feline, or minotaur aspects, hunters of boundless wildlands.

species.name: Halfling
species.desc: Clever, jovial, and nimble folk who build peaceful pastoral burrows or intricate clockwork workshops.

species.name: Giant
species.desc: Colossal beings of primeval stone, frost, and storm, keeping ancient memory of the world's dawn.

species.name: Goblin
species.desc: Prolific, cunning, and resourceful tinkerers who thrive in shadowy crevices, mines, and scrap cities.

species.name: Dragonborn
species.desc: Scale-bound noble warriors descended from dragons, wielding elemental breath and stubborn pride.

species.name: Merfolk
species.desc: Aquatic humanoids of the coral reefs and sunlit shallows, rulers of the pelagic depths.

species.name: Starborn
species.desc: Luminous beings born of falling stars and astral conduits, radiating transcendent grace.

species.name: Ratfolk
species.desc: Cunning subterranean rodentkin and warpstone tinkerers who breed rapidly in foul under-empires.

species.name: Lizardfolk
species.desc: Cold-blooded ancient guardians of the geomantic web who defend temple-cities under primal mandates.

species.name: Tomb Revenant
species.desc: Ancient slumbering skeletal pharaohs and living-metal monarchs commanding eternal legions.

species.name: Ogor
species.desc: Massive nomadic brute warriors driven by eternal hunger and gut-magic across mountains and steppes.

species.name: Void Elf
species.desc: Ancient psychic wanderers of cosmic webways with spirit stones preserving souls against the void.

species.name: Warp Fiend
species.desc: Horned warp-manifestations born of cosmic fractures and excess emotion hungry for slaughter.

species.name: Chitin Swarm
species.desc: Synaptic bio-constructs with chittering carapaces driven by a devouring hive-mind.
